text_block_list.text:
To uncover the true nature of the dream 
and draw closer to Eden, Gold Ship 
challenges Nakayama Festa.

Spicy food showdown! Gold Ship threw up 
something! Sit-up showdown! 100 in a 
minute, and she threw up again! Giving it 
their all, the ties keep continuing.

With the Trainer watching, the final 
statue imitation showdown took place. 
Under the gaze of the crowd, the victor 
was Gold Ship!

On the way home, Gold Ship told her 
Trainer that someone in her dream told her 
to come to Eden or something like that.

Does a dream really have anything to do 
with Eden? Leaving the puzzled Trainer 
behind, Gold Ship sprints away at full 
power.
